title: sida dissecta
intro: Sida dissecta, commonly known as the 'Cut-leaf Sida', is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Sida dissecta include wound healing, pain relief, and anti-diarrheal effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's overall therapeutic potential, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
